description:
FILED s531a (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-01) from #1815's implementation.  PRE-EXISTING in the sense that hooks did not load at all before s531a.

PCL loads a hook's source by spooling it to a private temporary file (%p-inc-hook-spool, cl/pcl-runtime.lisp) and transpiling that file on the uncached path, so the code's __FILE__, caller() file and every die/warn location name the spool path.  perl names the file `/loader/0x<addr>/NAME` -- or, when the hook stored $INC{NAME} itself before returning, THAT string (t/op/inccode.t: $INC{$filename} = "/custom/path/to/$filename" then __FILE__ eq it, and warn() reports it).

REPRO (perl 5.40.3):
  unshift @INC, sub { return unless $_[1] eq 'Fh.pm'; $INC{$_[1]} = '/custom/Fh.pm'; open my $fh, '<', \"package Fh; \$main::f = __FILE__; 1;"; $fh };
  require Fh; print "$main::f\n";      # perl /custom/Fh.pm   PCL /tmp/pcl-inc-XXXXXX/Fh.pm

FIX SHAPE: the transpiler needs a display-name input (pl2cl --source-name exists for programs: check whether module mode honours it), fed from %INC when the hook set it, else perl's /loader/0x.../NAME.  op/inccode.t's "__FILE__ set correctly" and "warn() reports correct file source" rows.

=== MEASURED (s532b, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-06) -- not fixed: not one string ===
Probe scratch/s532b/pr/p4161.pl (perl 5.40.3 / tree 1cec13ab+s532b): a hook that stores $INC{'Fh.pm'} = '/custom/Fh.pm' before returning its handle, and one that does not (Gh):
  __FILE__      perl /custom/Fh.pm            PCL /tmp/pcl-inc-XXXXXX/Fh.pm
  die location  perl "dd at /custom/Fh.pm line 1."   PCL "dd at /tmp/pcl-inc-XXXXXX/Fh.pm line 1."
  no preset     perl /loader/0x<ADDR>/Gh.pm (__FILE__ and the die)   PCL /tmp/pcl-inc-XXXXXX/Gh.pm
  (caller(0))[1] of a hook-module sub called from main: perl the script name, PCL the main script's CACHE path (~/.pcl-cache/scripts/HEX.lisp) -- but that is #233's ".lisp filename" (deferred, USER s488): a NORMAL module's sub answers the same (p4161b.pl), the hook path adds nothing.
Why it is not one string: the spool file's name reaches the transpiler as its PATH (%p-inc-hook-load -> p-load-module-cached PATH t -> %p-load-module-uncached -> p-transpile-file SOURCE-PATH).  The display name needs (1) a name argument threaded through those three calls, (2) pl2cl's `--as NAME` (#2460, program mode: $0 / __FILE__ / die locations) honoured in `--module` mode for __FILE__ and the file-id registry WITHOUT touching $0, and (3) perl's `/loader/0x<addr>/NAME` built from the hook element's address (the same hex p-refaddr prints) when the hook stored no string entry -- read from %INC AFTER the hook returned (the PRESET flag %p-require-locate already carries, task #1815).  A small batch of its own; op/inccode.t's "__FILE__ set correctly" and "warn() reports correct file source" rows are its acceptance.
subject: A module loaded through an @INC HOOK reports __FILE__ / die locations as the spool file /tmp/pcl-inc-XXXXXX/NAME; perl says /loader/0x.../NAME, or the %INC entry the hook stored before returning
